The wall-clock deadline does not cover DNS resolution (getaddrinfo cannot be interrupted), so no total end-to-end time guarantee is claimed for a manifest that names a hostname; use literal IPs or already-resolvable hosts. The budget guard charges one token per serialized request byte, an upper bound roughly four times stricter than chars/4.

The seed's elapsed cap must cover the whole run, including a real 65 s wait. Preflight and seed block a cap below TTL + margin + tail (95 s), but that floor is necessary, not sufficient: the cap must also cover seeding the positive account and the calls before the wait.
